- Group by the sol in the LTST string; do not substitute the LMST sol in the filename. The sol 700 file includes evening data from LTST sol 699.

- First take the median within each local hour, then the median of the hourly medians within the window. At least two hourly bins are required to produce a window value. This constrains only the time distribution and does not establish continuous observation throughout the window.
- Output a sampled day–night contrast only if both windows of the same LTST sol are adequate. This value is not the full daily maximum minus minimum, and it has not been confirmed that the two windows view the same ground patch.
- Only positive temperatures and nonnegative finite uncertainty enter exploratory summaries. Full quality screening additionally requires all six flags to be 1: wheels outside the downward field of view, low tilt, ground footprint outside shadow, HGA off, SkyCam off, and rover stationary.
